verdict.rationale: Anrok is a SaaS tax-compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible axis, but the evidence pack only shows REST/OpenAPI-style APIs and mentions of 'agents' consuming Anrok's tax engine (anrok-docs-16, anrok-docs-30) without any documented MCP server, protocol, or endpoint. Probes for llms.txt and openapi.json also 404, further indicating no discoverable agent-native interface.
